requirement: The Habeas Codicem book MUST configure mdBook's Git repository link for `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem` and its page edit links for the `main` branch.
rationale:
`requirements.layout.repository_links` has two obligations. `book.toml` must set mdBook's Git repository link to `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem`. It must also set page edit links for the `main` branch.

The test `tests/repository.rs#fn[book_links_to_the_repository_and_main_branch_edit_pages]` covers both. The helpers `repository_toml` and `repository_file` read the real `book.toml` from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR` and parse it as TOML. The test then makes two exact-value assertions:
- `output.html.git-repository-url` equals `https://github.com/nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem`.
- `output.html.edit-url-template` equals `https://github.com/nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem/edit/main/{path}`.

A wrong repository, a wrong branch, a missing key or a template without `{path}` would each fail one of these assertions. The requirement names no other input classes, boundaries or failure cases, so I found no gaps.
